headline.purpose: The column heading on the case side.

title.purpose: Step names and the name in the rail.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Surfaces stay flat. Depth is tonal: Clinic Ground, Work White, then the amber band.

motion.name: fact-wash
motion.purpose: A changed fact row washes from Selection Line to transparent. Removed when prefers-reduced-motion is set.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The forward action. Black type on Signal Cyan, with a Deep Signal border.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0891B2; color: #000; border: 1px solid #0E7490; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 18px; min-height: 48px; font: 700 18px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #06B6D4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0891B2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The back action. White fill, ink type, Selection Line border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #164E63; border: 1px solid #A5F3FC; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 18px; min-height: 48px; font: 700 18px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #0891B2; background: #F0FDFA; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0891B2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A single-line entry. White, 20px type, Selection Line border, cyan caret.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; background: #FFFFFF; color: #164E63; border: 1px solid #A5F3FC; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 20px/1.4 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; caret-color: #0891B2; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #A5F3FC; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0891B2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Numeric Field
components.description: A clinical figure. The text field with tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-field-num { display: block; width: 100%; background: #FFFFFF; color: #164E63; border: 1px solid #A5F3FC; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 20px/1.4 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; caret-color: #0891B2; } .ds-field-num:hover { border-color: #A5F3FC; } .ds-field-num:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0891B2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Step
components.description: A step in the rail. The name is ink; the status word is Deep Signal.
components.css: .ds-step { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #FFFFFF; color: #164E63; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; font: 700 18px/1.3 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-step small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; color: #0E7490; } .ds-step:hover { border-color: #0891B2; } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0891B2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Current Step
components.description: The step in progress. Name and status word are black on Signal Cyan.
components.css: .ds-step-current { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #0891B2; color: #000; border: 1px solid #0E7490; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; font: 700 18px/1.3 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-step-current small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; color: #000; } .ds-step-current:hover { background: #0891B2; border-color: #0891B2; } .ds-step-current:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0891B2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Warning Band
components.description: Full amber caution across the entry column.
components.html: Tashxis emas. Yakuniy qaror shifokorga tegishli. Klinik production emas.
components.css: .ds-alert { margin: 0; background: #FEF3C7; color: #451A03; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 16px/1.5 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-alert:hover { background: #FEF3C7; } .ds-alert:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0891B2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Fact Row
components.description: One line of the case. A change washes the row for 700ms.
components.html: Yosh va jins45 yosh, ayol
components.css: .ds-fact { border-top: 1px solid #A5F3FC; padding: 10px 0; font: 400 16px/1.5 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: #164E63; } .ds-fact b { display: block; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #0E7490; } .ds-fact-changed { animation: ds-yozildi 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes ds-yozildi { from { background: #A5F3FC; } to { background: transparent; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-fact-changed { animation: none; } } .ds-fact:hover { color: #164E63; } .ds-fact:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0891B2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Choice Row
components.description: A single-choice source row. White, Selection Line border, cyan radio.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; background: #FFFFFF; color: #164E63; border: 1px solid #A5F3FC; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 16px/1.5 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-choice input { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-top: 3px; accent-color: #0891B2; } .ds-choice b { display: block; font-weight: 700; } .ds-choice p { margin: 4px 0 0; } .ds-choice:hover { background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-choice input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0891B2; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The Case Spine is a full-height work surface for one case. Steps sit in a narrow column on the left, the current entry fills the center, and the case rewrites itself in the column on the right. The conclusion is a later screen. This is an operate surface: dense, quiet, and meant to be read at a workstation. The screen assembles the case and leaves the decision with the physician.

The palette is a pale cyan ground, white columns, and a single cyan accent. Caution is a full amber band. Status is written as a word. Secondary lines use the deep accent. Surfaces are flat, and depth is a change of tone: ground, white column, amber band.

Motion is rare. When a fact changes, that row washes for 700ms and settles. If the reader prefers reduced motion, the wash is removed. Type is one face, Atkinson Hyperlegible, in two weights: 400 for reading and 700 for headings, steps, actions, and labels.
keyCharacteristics: One cyan accent on a pale ground and white columns
Status carried by a word, with the current step in black on the accent
Flat surfaces, with depth made by tone
Three independently scrolling columns, and a sticky step rail when the window is narrow

rules.name: The Status-in-Words Rule
rules.body: Status is a word — tayyor, hali yo‘q, ogohlantirish, kutilmoqda, or kiritilgan. Color does not carry status by itself. On the current step the word is black on the accent.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal cyan is the only accent. The amber pair is the warning surface. Secondary text is Deep Signal.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Lab values, rates, and table cells use tabular numerals so columns of figures stay aligned.

rules.name: The Own Scroll Rule
rules.body: The three columns fill the viewport and each one scrolls on its own. At 960px and below, the step rail sticks to the top, fields stack in one column, and the case panel follows the entry.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Depth is Clinic Ground, then Work White, then the amber band.

rules.name: The Two Radii Rule
rules.body: Fields, steps, the warning band, tables, and the case note use a 12px corner. Actions use an 8px corner.

dos: Do write status as one of these words: tayyor, hali yo‘q, ogohlantirish, kutilmoqda, kiritilgan.
Do put black text on the accent for the current step and the primary action.
Do paint caution as a full amber band, amber ink on Amber Band, with a 12px corner.
Do set secondary text in the deep accent.
Do draw a 3px accent focus ring, offset 2px, on keyboard focus.
Do use tabular numerals on clinical figures.
Do wash a changed fact row for 700ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and disable that animation under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add a second accent, gray secondary text, or a drop shadow.
Don't communicate status by color alone.
Don't place an eyebrow or kicker above a heading, and don't use emoji as icons.
Don't set headings or field labels in uppercase.
Don't invent a font weight between 400 and 700.
